name: Aerial Survey

start.dialog: Mapping the Prism from above! But need ground confirmation! See those crystal formations? Need you to mark the ones that resonate! Use these survey markers!
start.objective: Place survey markers on resonating crystal formations throughout Prism

progress.dialog: Getting good data from above! How's the ground work? Found any strong resonance points?
progress.objective: Continue placing markers on crystal formations

complete.dialog: Survey complete! The data is... fascinating! The crystals are aligning with something! Here - take this sky chart. Shows hidden routes above the clouds!

party_comments.kade: Interesting... the crystals form a pattern. Like a map.
party_comments.ashka: Sky routes. Could be useful for my drake.
party_comments.nix7: Crystal alignment suggests artificial formation. Investigation warranted.

hidden_outcome: If you mark all 10 hidden formations (not just the 5 required), the Aeronaut gives you 'Aether Wings' - permanent slow-fall ability
